acts.palette: moss green, sandstone tan, slate gray, autumn ochre, antique brass, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical illustration, overhead papercraft diorama of a rugged park journey, read bottom to top. Begin at a sandstone trailhead with a rusted barrier and ochre leaf-covered fork; climb past abandoned camps, a steaming spring with copper pipes, a dark cave mouth and small plant capsules, then reach a high clearing of folded contour maps and sealed specimen pens where the Forever Preserve waits. Leave a broad, uncluttered middle ground for path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide fight background for floors 1–5: a quiet sandstone park trail with low mossy banks, scattered ochre leaves, distant tent silhouettes and a small rusted gate off to one side. A few teal hexagonal paper tiles creep along an outer edge. Low contrast, open central fighting space, no central subject; layered grainy construction paper, crisp cut edges, brass pins and soft shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

Wide fight background for floors 6–10: the same park farther uphill, with a muted spring, copper pipe, folded map ridges and small sealed plant pods along the margins. Teal hexagonal growth spreads in connected patches across banks and around the pipe, leaving the center open. Low contrast, no central subject; grainy layered construction paper, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

Wide fight background for floors 11–15: a subdued clearing of braced trail exits, folded green map sheets and empty enclosure frames at the edges. Dense teal hexagonal growth covers much of the banks and climbs the frames, suggesting the park is being sealed; keep the center open and low contrast. No central subject; grainy layered construction paper, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Full-body, imposing Forever Preserve: a huge walking vault with a broad rectangular gray stone body, heavy jointed legs and folded green map sheets layered across its shoulders and trailing beneath its feet. Overlapping brass doors part enough to reveal pale glasslike paper specimen pods. Give it a strong fortress silhouette, centered with space around every limb, viewed slightly from below. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

acts.palette: walnut brown, parchment cream, mineral blue, pale crystal white, antique brass, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical illustration, overhead papercraft diorama of a mineral collection and adjoining workshops, read bottom to top. Begin among orderly wooden specimen cases and pale crystal trays; proceed past a cracked warm-battery case, a narrow crystal-coated bridge, drafting desks with abstract unmarked diagrams and a workshop of folding beams and pipes. At the top, a broad construction bay holds the Cabinet of Tomorrow. Leave the middle ground open for readable path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide fight background for floors 1–5: muted walnut display cabinets, pale angular minerals and a cracked case with a soft blue lamp, arranged along the far wall and outer edges. A few teal hexagonal tiles appear at the baseboards. Low contrast, open center, no central subject; grainy layered construction paper, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

Wide fight background for floors 6–10: a quiet museum workshop with folded cream model walls, brass beams, crystal trays and pipes at the margins. Connected teal hexagonal growth climbs several cases and crosses sections of the floor near the edges. Low contrast, open center, no central subject; grainy layered construction paper, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

Wide fight background for floors 11–15: the workshop increasingly enclosed by muted construction frames, pale crystal cases and water pipes; dense teal hexagonal growth plates the side walls, beams and outer floor. Keep the middle clear and subdued for small creatures. No central subject; grainy layered construction paper, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Full-body, imposing Cabinet of Tomorrow: a huge dark walnut cabinet on sturdy brass-rimmed wheels, armored with pale angular crystal specimen cases. Folding beams rise from its shoulders and a ring of long articulated construction arms reaches outward, giving it a broad unmistakable silhouette. A simple unmarked water diagram hangs inside its open frame. Center the entire machine with space around its arms and wheels, viewed slightly from below. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

acts.palette: limestone gray, chalk white, slate blue, muddy brown, antique brass, swarm teal
acts.map: Tall vertical illustration, overhead papercraft cutaway diorama of connected karst, read bottom to top. Start at a surface well and cracked sinkhole, descend visually through winding limestone passages to a spring, narrow channels, a white stone column and sealed water conduits, then climb the image to a vast underground chamber where the Karst Mandate waits. Show the same slate-blue water linking well and spring. Leave a broad open middle ground for readable path lines. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.
backdrops: Wide fight background for floors 1–5: a muted limestone passage with a shallow slate-blue stream, muddy bank, scattered stone and a small cracked opening at the edge. A few teal hexagonal tiles cling to the outer rock. Low contrast, open center, no central subject; grainy layered construction paper, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

Wide fight background for floors 6–10: a wider karst chamber with a pale stone column, branching water channels and muted brass pipes along the sides. Teal hexagonal growth spreads over ledges and partly seals one side channel, while water remains visible. Low contrast, open center, no central subject; grainy layered construction paper, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.

Wide fight background for floors 11–15: a deep chamber of layered gray rock and constricted waterways, with braced conduits and broken drill marks along the edges. Dense teal hexagonal growth blankets the walls and chokes most side channels; a thin slate-blue current still threads through. Keep the center open and subdued. No central subject; grainy layered construction paper, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins and shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.
acts.boss: Full-body, imposing Karst Mandate rising from a broken cave floor: a vast gray stone and brass machine with a prominent circular spring-mouth core, three distinct jointed drilling limbs and a tall narrow survey mast. A ribbon of slate-blue water emerges from the core; visible linkages connect the mast and limbs to it. Give the whole machine a strong wide silhouette, with all three drill tips and the mast fully visible, viewed slightly from below. Layered construction paper with visible grain, flat color, crisp hand-cut edges, brass pins at joints and dramatic shadow-theatre lighting. No logos or readable text.
